name: What are the common reasons homeowners enlarge windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the common reasons homeowners enlarge windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners typically enlarge windows to increase natural light, improve ventilation, enhance views, or update the aesthetic appeal of a room. For example, a small window might be replaced with a larger picture window or French doors to create a brighter, more open living space. During our initial consultation, we discuss your goals and help identify the best type of window enlargement to achieve your desired outcome, considering factors like room orientation and existing wall space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common reasons include increasing natural light, improving ventilation, enhancing views, or updating aesthetics.
